title: Private noise contracts a finite-dimensional observer under acquired local cuts
statement: Under the supplied finite-dimensional local-cut protocol and private full-rank onsite noise, a block-state observer has a uniform current conditional-state trace-distance allowance for every supported record, as well as for future physical experiments started from its encoded state. The stored real-coordinate count is at most (N/B)d^(2B); sufficient precision is logarithmic in N and inverse tolerance when d, B and noise strength are fixed, with exponential dependence on B.

requires: Finite-dimensional local system and supplied partition whose blocks remain at most B under actual visible measure-and-prepare cuts.
Independent private full-rank onsite replacement noise after each sweep, with private noise labels unavailable to the observer.
A legitimate initial encoded state or the stated visible-cut initialization procedure; finite work between sweeps and the supplied local-operation/model contract.
provides: Uniform current-state trace-distance control for every supported complete received history.
Same bound for a common future physical experiment started from the encoded state.
Positive block-state representation with at most (N/B)d^(2B) real coordinates and explicit sufficient precision.
assumptions: The block partition is maintained by actual visible local cuts; it is not inferred from spatial adjacency or a posterior factorization.
For a future-from-encoded-state comparison, the environment is fresh Markov with no inaccessible memory that later reconnects.
The uniform guarantee covers each supported current record and a common future physical experiment started from the encoded state; it is not a whole-infinite-record constant-error guarantee.
costs: At most (N/B)d^(2B) independent real coordinates; sufficient precision is logarithmic in N and inverse tolerance for fixed d, B and noise strength, with exponential dependence on B.
Physical cuts and private noise change the experiment; partition, model, controller, caches and working arrays are additional costs.
The 10,000-site 4.8 MB figure is symbolic payload only; no 10,000-site execution was performed. The audit reports 48 exact finite rational cases, but producer code was not replayed in this intake.
contract.units: State coordinates and precision under the source contract; no automatic conversion to total infinite-record error.
contract.obstruction: No guarantee for unrestricted uncut dynamics, fixed total error over the whole infinite record, arbitrary bosonic thermal spaces, or advantage over same-information density-filter/tensor comparators.

body:
N990-p1-bounded-observer-under-local-cuts | Private noise contracts a finite-dimensional observer under acquired local cuts

STATUS | Source-derived theorem and implementation-audit report; scoped review pending. The claim concerns the altered protocol with physical local cuts and private onsite noise. It is not a simulation of the uncut experiment or an established practical advantage.

EXACT CLAIM
For a finite-dimensional lattice with a supplied block partition of maximum size B maintained by visible local measure-and-prepare cuts, apply independent private full-rank onsite replacement noise after each sweep. Under the stated finite-operation and model conditions, a positive block-state observer maintains a uniform trace-distance allowance for every supported current record and for future physical experiments started from the encoded state. The state uses at most (N/B)d^(2B) independent real coordinates, with sufficient precision growing logarithmically in N and inverse tolerance when d, B and noise strength are fixed. Dependence on B remains exponential.

PHYSICAL CONTRACT
The cut is part of the physical protocol: it separates the measured site while retaining the conditionally updated remainder of its former block as one component. Remote entanglement is not split by assuming spatial adjacency. Private noise labels are not observer inputs. The initial state, local operations, maximum block size, finite work between sweeps and noise lower bound must satisfy the source contract.

SOURCE-REPORTED FINITE EXAMPLE
The selected report describes an N=4, B=2, b=34 two-qubit control with 512 sweeps, 2048 weak marks and 510 visible endpoint cuts, with a uniform current-state allowance 31/67108864. Its independent audit text reports 48 exact noise/rounding cases. No producer code was selected or replayed in this intake. The 10,000-site, 4.8 MB coordinate payload is a theoretical scaling calculation, not an execution; it excludes partition, model, controller, cache and working-array costs.

LIMITS AND COMPARATORS
A fixed current-state error does not give a fixed error for the whole infinite record; that requires a separate summable error schedule with growing precision. The theorem is exponential in B and the cuts/noise change the experiment. The positive finite-dimensional cone floor does not transfer to the unbounded bosonic thermal space using mean energy alone. Conventional density filters and tensor methods receive the same information and are direct comparators; exclusive advantage is not established. This result is distinct from N959's classical local-preparation record and does not validate that claim.

EVIDENCE
The governing theorem, dedicated block-partition proof, internal audit, finite example and non-transfer limits are indexed in the attached source index. Internal source exposure is not external review; external correctness, novelty, physical value and practical advantage remain UNKNOWN.

review.scope: Internal source-exposed review accepts the positive finite-bit encoding, independent-onsite recurrence and stated four-site all-record bound at the exact overlay scope; code replay, a 10,000-site execution, external validation and practical advantage are excluded.
